# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `keenable` MCP server pointing at Keenable's hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://api.keenable.ai/mcp`).
- No API key: the server answers on the shared public tier, matching Keenable's one-click Cursor install.
- Logo: Keenable's official mark, from the `keenableai/keenable-mcp` repository.
